metadata.source: Geofabrik Shandong OSM extract 2026-10-11; local OSM XML reef outlines
metadata.note: Only closed natural=beach polygons. Coastline intersection is used to identify the wet edge; no hand-drawn shore extensions.

groundCutMask.source: Exact natural=beach polygons and holes from /data/beaches.json; Geofabrik Shandong OSM extract 2026-10-11; local OSM XML reef outlines
groundCutMask.uv: u=(x-minX)/(maxX-minX), v=(maxZ-z)/(maxZ-minZ), Texture invertY=false; clamp both axes
groundCutMask.encoding: RGBA white RGB 255; alpha 0 beach / 255 remaining terrain. Read alpha, not RGB.
groundCutMask.antialiasing: 4x supersampled exact polygon coverage, BOX downsampling; boundary pixels only, no Gaussian blur or footprint dilation
